purpose_context: Consumers of spec-kitty-events read the transition contract to decide which backward moves a reviewer may make. Two rewinds to in_progress are guarded by a review reference rather than force, but the contract never says so and no fixture pins it, so a consumer can generalise the force rule and break them. This mission names and pins that second family without changing behaviour (spec-kitty-events#48).
purpose_tldr: Make the shared status contract say plainly which backward review moves need force and which need a review reference.
